summary: Multi-user viewer role fully verified. Backend (23/23 pytest) and frontend (all UI assertions) pass. Registration creates viewer with cookie+token, 409 on dup email, 400 on short password. Viewer forbidden (403) on all 9 admin writes (players POST/DELETE, seasons POST/PATCH/activate/DELETE, matches POST/PUT/DELETE) with 'Admin privileges required'. Viewer allowed on all GETs and POST /matchmaking/balance. Admin regression (login + CRUD) passes. Frontend: Login page shows auth-tab-login + auth-tab-register; register fields present and submission redirects to '/' as viewer. nav-user-role badge renders 'VIEWER' / 'ADMIN' correctly. nav-log hidden for viewer, deep-link /log redirects to '/'. Matches rows show no match-edit/match-delete pencils; Players hides add form + delete btns; Seasons hides create form + edit/activate/delete controls. Matchmaking page loads with full player pool for viewer. Admin regression (nav-log visible, add forms visible) OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1000 lines — split auth/matches/stats/matchmaking into separate routers.
Users collection has no admin management endpoint; TEST_ viewer accounts created during testing cannot be cleaned up via API (acceptable, but leaves TEST_* rows in DB).
Register endpoint does not strip/normalise `name` beyond falling back to email prefix; consider trimming whitespace length limit.
Login/Register responses both include 'token' in the body AND set httpOnly cookie — fine, but if front-end doesn't use the token, consider dropping it from the body to reduce exposure.
Validation duplication between create_match and update_match (noted in iter 9) still unresolved.
test_credentials: admin@arenaops.gg / admin123. Viewer accounts created on-the-fly with TEST_viewer_<uuid>@test.com / viewerpass123.
seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture auto-creates a TEST_viewer_<uuid>@test.com viewer per module. Admin-created TEST_mm_* / TEST_admin_* / TEST_season_* rows are deleted during the same test. TEST_viewer_* rows persist (no admin user-delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Role-based access tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_viewer_role.py. Auth uses httpOnly cookies via /api/auth/register and /api/auth/login; subsequent requests reuse the same requests.Session() to send cookies. Frontend `data-testid`s used: auth-tab-login, auth-tab-register, register-name/email/password, login-email/password, login-submit, register-submit, nav-user-role, nav-log, match-edit-*, match-delete-*, player-name-input, player-add-btn, player-delete-*, season-name-input, season-add-btn, season-edit-*, season-activate-*, season-delete-*.
